old_problem: A retrain can preserve endpoint enumeration while changing LTSSM, speed, width and error state. Final lspci/dmesg evidence cannot show that each of 10,000 requested retrains completed within bounds without transient downtraining or errors.
disposition_reason: The source fixes retrain semantics, exact count and no-error outcome. Vendor primitive, target hierarchy, expected LTSSM path, negotiated state/deadline, durable evidence and recovery are suitable Project Configuration. A transaction ledger resolves the review without reducing the 10,000-event coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2118, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2119 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00040-V002 / 76c631ba81e20add was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
This row is 10,000 retrain transactions, distinct from preceding link disable/enable and following L1 power-state transitions.
Bind the exact approved LTSSM/NVQual retrain primitive to one mapped root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint/GPU path and known sibling blast radius.
For each entry record request, LTSSM progression, enumeration continuity, settled generation/width within deadline, and fresh AER/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power deltas before enabling the next retrain.
A final healthy link, tool restart, setup action, partial transaction or retry is not a successful count; any compressed ledger must be lossless and gap-detecting.
Stop on wrong scope, retrain timeout/failure, downtraining, endpoint/sibling loss, new disqualifying AER/reset, evidence gap or safety anomaly.
Preserve first-fault artifacts, do not clear counters or automatically retry, and recover only through the signed out-of-band path.
No retrain, LTSSM/NVQual, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Prove exactly 10,000 deliberate retrains on the mapped link, each settling within deadline at approved generation/width with enumeration continuity and no disqualifying error.
required_package: Pinned approved NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual retrain build, primitive and configuration
Immutable root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint/GPU and sibling topology map
Approved LTSSM trajectory, generation/width, enumeration, transient, deadline and error rules
10,000-entry durable ledger/checkpoint and first-fault interlock policy
Dedicated idle SUT, out-of-band console, stable power/cooling and tested recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve topology/link/error/health baselines; after point approval execute only the pinned retrain primitive for entries 1..10000. For every entry durably record request, LTSSM path, enumeration continuity, settled generation/width, deadline, errors and health before enabling the next retrain. Stop on first anomaly or artifact gap; do not clear or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 10,000 entries show the approved path retrained and settled within deadline at required generation/width with endpoints/siblings present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error, and approved final topology/health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until primitive, target/path, LTSSM/gen/width/deadline/error contract, ledger and recovery are approved. PASS requires 10,000 complete accepted retrains. FAIL on wrong scope, timeout/downtrain, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; retries do not count.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact retrain primitive/path, acceptance, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console, stable power/cooling and explicit 10,000-retrain authorization.
Commit every complete transaction before the next request.
Stop without counter clearing, forced continuation or retry on first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, tool/configuration and point authorization
Complete target/sibling topology and retrain/LTSSM/gen/width/deadline/error contract
Gap-detecting ledger 1..10000 with raw request, path, settle, timing and disposition
Per-cycle or lossless checkpoint health correlation plus restart/artifact-integrity audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final endpoint/link/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first wrong scope, failed/late/downtrained retrain, endpoint/sibling loss, disqualifying error/reset or evidence gap, inhibit all later requests and preserve the event. Do not replay; follow signed recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.
